global_rules.membership_timing: Every family membership rule is fixed before any member result is inspected.
global_rules.missing_invalid_prespecified_member_rule: Fail closed rather than shrinking the family; if a numeric p-value vector is required, substitute p=1.0 for the missing/invalid member.
global_rules.promotion_authority: Only designated promotion families may support promotion claims.

members.claim: Kronos-only primary promotion against the frozen strongest comparable V1 control.
Indicators-only I-ALL primary promotion against the frozen strongest comparable V1 control.

F82_83_COMPONENT_PROMOTION.semantics: Exactly one primary promotion p-value per component. Secondary, ablation, attribution, or sensitivity tests cannot enter, replace, or rescue a member.

F83_ATTRIBUTION.semantics: Explanatory attribution only. These claims cannot promote or rescue I-ALL, replace P83_V1, or authorize a reduced aggregate after I-ALL fails or is invalid.

F84_ALL_REQUIRED_COMPARATORS.semantics: All three required comparator claims must independently satisfy the frozen material, uncertainty, robustness, and adjusted-q gates. A missing or invalid comparator fails #84 closed and cannot be dropped.

F85_SENSITIVITY.membership_rule: All and only p-values from the exact #85 sensitivity-member manifest frozen before the first #85 empirical inspection, covering only preregistered secondary horizons and/or regime sensitivity tests.
F85_SENSITIVITY.semantics: #85 evidence cannot rescue a failed #82/#83/#84 promotion gate or replace the V1-comparable primary target/horizon.
